directoryReadFailed: Cannot read this directory. Check the path and permissions.
directorySelectionHint: Open folders to browse. Select folders to create one workspace per folder.

worktree.name: Task name
worktree.notice: Creates an independent directory from a committed version. Uncommitted changes are not copied. Removing the workspace keeps its directory and Git branch.

worktreeManager.title: Manage Worktrees
worktreeManager.description: Discover worktrees in this workspace’s repositories, open them, or safely remove them.
worktreeManager.refreshHint: Refreshes every 10 seconds while viewing. Upstream counts use local refs; no automatic fetch.
worktreeManager.ignoredDeleteNotice: The following ignored files and directories (including their contents) will also be deleted. Confirm deletion to continue.
worktreeManager.deleteNotice: This removes the directory and {count} associated workspace(s), including their layouts. The local branch is kept unless selected below. Files cannot be recovered through Purplemux.
worktreeManager.targetRef: Branch into which this work has been merged
worktreeManager.mergeNotice: The target must be another local or remote-tracking branch. All commits must be merged into it. Git may still retain the branch if its own deletion checks fail.
worktreeManager.workspaceCleanupFailed: The worktree was deleted, but a workspace record could not be removed. Remove that workspace separately.
worktreeManager.branchRetained: The worktree was deleted. The branch was retained because Git could not safely delete it.

reasons.dirty: Commit or move uncommitted and untracked files first
reasons.ignored: Ignored files or directories need confirmation. Go back, refresh the list, and confirm deletion again.
reasons.sessions: Close the associated Purplemux terminals and agents first
reasons.detached: Create a branch to preserve detached HEAD before deletion
reasons.sharedWorkspace: A workspace also references directories outside this worktree, or another worktree is nested here
reasons.notFound: Worktree or workspace no longer exists. Refresh the list.
reasons.changed: HEAD or branch changed. Refresh and review before deleting.
reasons.targetRequired: Choose another local or remote-tracking branch as the merge target
reasons.notMerged: Some commits have not been merged into the selected target
reasons.operation: Finish or abort the existing Git operation first
reasons.batchSource: Remove the workspace hosting this panel separately
reasons.noOperation: There is no Git operation to continue or abort
reasons.targetChanged: The target moved. Refresh and review the comparison again.
reasons.ignoredCollision: The operation could overwrite ignored files. Move them out of the worktree first.
reasons.reviewUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS GitHub PR or GitLab MR URL
reasons.reviewRemote: The PR/MR repository does not match a configured remote
reasons.reviewMismatch: The PR/MR source branch does not match this worktree
reasons.reviewCliMissing: Install and authenticate gh for GitHub or glab for GitLab
reasons.reviewUnavailable: Cannot refresh PR/MR status. Check CLI authentication, network access, and repository permissions.
reasons.branchNotPublished: Publish the current commit to the selected remote first.
reasons.targetNotPublished: The target branch does not exist on the selected remote.
reasons.pushFailed: Push failed. Check authentication and remote history; force push is not used.
reasons.draftCreateFailed: Creation was not confirmed. Check the remote before retrying; the next attempt checks for existing open PRs/MRs.
reasons.draftAssociationFailed: The PR/MR exists, but its local association could not be saved. Keep this link and associate it again.

worktreeManager.organizationHint: Up to 50 per batch. Unknown opening times are excluded from idle filters. The current workspace must be removed separately.
worktreeManager.batchNotice: Only eligible directories and their associated workspaces will be deleted. All branches are kept. Each item is checked again before deletion. Files cannot be restored through Purplemux.
worktreeManager.batchEligible: {eligible} of {total} selected worktrees can be deleted.
worktreeManager.syncDescription: Compare against a target branch, then merge or rebase the current worktree. Remote refs stay local until you fetch. No automatic push.
worktreeManager.targetCounts: Current branch: {ahead} unique commits; {behind} target commits missing.
worktreeManager.integrated: The target contains the current commit history. Squash merges may have different ancestry.
worktreeManager.syncConfirm: Run {action} with target {target} on current branch {branch}? The target branch itself is unchanged.
worktreeManager.rebaseNotice: Rebase rewrites the current branch’s commits. Check whether this history is already shared before proceeding.
worktreeManager.abortNotice: Abort the ongoing Git operation and return to its starting state? Conflict resolutions made during this operation may be discarded.
worktreeManager.resolveNotice: Resolve conflicts and stage the resolutions in a terminal, then close associated terminals before continuing; or abort the operation.
worktreeManager.syncNeedsAttention: Git did not complete the operation. Review the output and current state.
worktreeManager.reviewHint: Link a PR/MR from a configured remote. Clear the URL to unlink. Status refresh requires an installed, authenticated gh (GitHub) or glab (GitLab).
worktreeManager.reviewHeadDiffers: The PR/MR source commit differs from the current HEAD; its state does not describe all current local work.
worktreeManager.draftHint: Requires an authenticated gh (GitHub) or glab (GitLab). Publish the current commit first; creation checks for an existing open PR/MR. Cross-repository drafts are not supported.
worktreeManager.pushConfirm: Push this exact commit to the selected remote branch? This is a normal push; a non-fast-forward update will be rejected.
worktreeManager.draftConfirm: Create a draft with the following repository, branches, title and description? This action will not push commits.
